ObjectName.value: Jan Szal designer Gwiazda Polski stratospheric balloon Powązki Military Cemetery Warsaw

Categories.value: Burials in Warsaw|Military Cemetery in Warsaw|History of aviation in Poland|Gwiazda Polski|Self-published work|Files with coordinates missing SDC location of creation|Balloon history|Files by User:Siarhei V|Photos in Warsaw taken by User:Siarhei V

ImageDescription.value: This photograph depicts the grave of Jan Alfred Szal—engineer, inventor, and patriot—at Powązki Military Cemetery (Cmentarz Wojskowy na Powązkach) in Warsaw, Poland. Szal was the designer of the pressurized gondola for the "Gwiazda Polski" ("Star of Poland"), at the time the world's largest stratospheric balloon, intended to reach a record altitude in 1938. The central section of the monument features an inscription dedicated to the balloon project, with a prominent sculptural element evoking the balloon's shape. Family members including Jan Alfred Szal, Barbara Szal-Karkowska, and others are also memorialized.

Artist.value: Siarhei Besarab
